zh.title: Royal Air Maroc 成非洲首家提供 Starlink 機上網服務航空公司
zh.summary: Royal Air Maroc；將提供 Starlink 機上網；首批2027年初完成
body: Royal Air Maroc 宣佈將成為非洲首家為機隊提供 Starlink 機上網連線的航空公司。
該航空公司計劃在 41 架飛機上提供 SpaceX 的高速低延遲衛星寬頻服務。
首批安裝預計於 2027 年初完成。
Starlink 服務將免費提供給 Safar Flyer 忠誠計畫成員。
根據 ch-aviation 數據，截至 2026 年 10 月，Royal Air Maroc 擁有 76 架航空器（含 VIP、貨運及閒置機隊）。

en.title: Royal Air Maroc to Become First African Airline to Offer Starlink In‑flight Connectivity
en.summary: Royal Air Maroc plans to equip 41 aircraft with Starlink, first installations expected early 2027
body: Royal Air Maroc announced it will become the first African airline to equip its fleet with Starlink inflight connectivity.
The airline plans to offer SpaceX’s high-speed, low-latency satellite broadband service on 41 of its aircraft.
The first installations are expected to be completed by early 2027.
The service will be provided free of charge to members of the Safar Flyer loyalty program.
According to ch-aviation data, as of October 2026, RAM operates a fleet of 76 aircraft (including VIP, cargo and inactive aircraft).

zh.title: 利雅德哈立德國王國際機場遭飛彈攻擊 12死309傷 航班暫停
zh.summary: 利雅德哈立德國王國際機場遭飛彈攻擊；12死309傷；所有航班暫停至10月12日午夜
body: 沙烏地阿拉伯民航總局（GACA）證實，一枚飛彈於2026年10月10日擊中利雅德哈立德國王國際機場（RUH），造成12人死亡、另有309人受傷。
沙烏地當局也證實，部分傷者傷勢危急，正在沙烏地首都多家醫院接受醫療照護。
根據AeroTime報導，這枚飛彈自葉門境內由胡塞組織控制的地區發射，似乎直接命中機場第三航廈。報導並指出，社羣媒體上出現據稱顯示撞擊瞬間及事後情況的影片。
攻擊發生後，哈立德國王國際機場所有作業立即暫停。這項航班禁令其後延長至沙烏地時間2026年10月12日午夜。
這起攻擊發生在另兩起攻擊機場事件後僅兩天。AeroTime報導，那兩起攻擊造成3名沙烏地國民死亡，包括一名Saudia機長，並嚴重損壞一架停放在機場登機門的Saudia空中巴士A320系列飛機；當時機上沒有乘客。
報導指出，在事發前幾天，葉門胡塞組織曾對沙烏地其他基礎設施發動飛彈攻擊，例如該國西南部的艾卜哈國際機場（AHB）。報導並稱，胡塞組織也威脅鎖定沙烏地重要的輸油管線與出口碼頭。
AeroTime報導，這些攻擊發生之際，沙烏地與盟軍對胡塞組織發動反攻，試圖收復該組織在葉門西南部一系列近期推進中奪取的土地。

en.title: Missile attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport kills 12, injures 309
en.summary: Riyadh King Khalid International Airport hit by missile; 12 killed, 309 injured; all operations suspended until Oct 12 midnight
body: A missile strike killed 12 people and injured another 309 at Riyadh King Khalid International Airport (RUH) on October 10, 2026, Saudi Arabia's General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) confirmed.
Saudi authorities also confirmed that a number of the injured are in critical condition and are receiving medical care at several hospitals in the Saudi capital.

According to AeroTime, the missile was launched from Houthi-controlled territory in Yemen and appears to have scored a direct hit on the airport's Terminal 3. Footage reportedly showing the moment of impact and its immediate aftermath has emerged on social media.
As a result of the attack, all operations at King Khalid International Airport were immediately suspended. The flight ban was later extended until at least midnight on October 12, 2026, Saudi time.

The attack came barely two days after two separate attacks on the airport killed three Saudi nationals, including a Saudia captain, and seriously damaged a Saudia Airbus A320-family aircraft which was parked at one of the airport's gates. No passengers were on board the aircraft at the time.

In the preceding days, Yemen's Houthis launched missile attacks on other Saudi infrastructure, such as Abha International Airport (AHB) in the southwest of the country, according to the report. The Houthis have also threatened to target the Kingdom's vital oil pipelines and export terminals.

AeroTime reported that these attacks came as Saudi and allied forces launched a counter-offensive against the Houthis in an attempt to recover territory the group had seized in a series of recent advances in southwestern Yemen.
